metadata.title: Presence and Availability

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for signaling participant availability, status, and engagement within collaboration environments.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Presence services, availability indicators, and collaboration signaling backplanes.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for controlled signaling of participant availability and engagement state without exposing unnecessary contextual detail.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Presence states, timestamps, availability indicators, client activity signals, and visibility metadata.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Presence and availability inherit baseline collaboration trust, identity context, and accountability from Collaboration Core.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Presence and availability signals often reflect remote work patterns and must be governed to avoid overexposure of user context.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Presence visibility across organizational or federated boundaries must respect defined trust relationships and information sharing agreements.

metadata.remarks: Presence and Availability defines how collaboration systems signal a participant’s availability and engagement state. While presence is not a communication channel itself, it materially influences trust decisions, targeting, and social engineering risk. This pattern governs visibility, accuracy, and contextual restraint of presence information while inheriting identity, boundary, and accountability guarantees from Collaboration Core.

components.title: Presence Identity Binding
components.description: Ensures presence status is consistently and correctly bound to the authenticated participant identity.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Misleading or spoofed presence indicators used to masquerade as another participant.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid accounts to manipulate presence signals and misrepresent availability or authority.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong identity binding ensures presence accurately reflects the authenticated participant.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Presence data is attributable to an authenticated identity.
Identity attributes are managed to ensure correct presence representation.

components.title: Presence Visibility Control
components.description: Restricts who may view presence and availability information and at what level of detail.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Account discovery and targeting through unrestricted visibility of presence or availability.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Access control over presence visibility limits reconnaissance and targeting risk.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Visibility of presence information is explicitly managed.
Enforcement mechanisms restrict unauthorized observation of presence.

components.title: Presence Accountability and Observability
components.description: Provides traceability of changes to presence state for governance, incident review, and misuse investigation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression or removal of evidence related to presence manipulation or misuse.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging of presence changes supports oversight and accountability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Presence state changes are defined and logged.
Audit review supports detection of anomalous or abusive presence behavior.
